name: Lazer UI
description: A smooth, music-reactive menu overhaul inspired by osu!lazer.

enabled.name: Enable Lazer menu
enabled.description: Replace the main menu with the Lazer-style menu. Takes effect next time the menu loads.

restyle-popups.name: Restyle popups
restyle-popups.description: Give GD's popups (rewards, confirmations, info boxes...) the dark osu!-style look. Other mods' popups are left alone.

music-player.name: Menu music player
music-player.description: Instead of the menu theme, play the songs of your downloaded levels one after another, and show the playing level's thumbnail (from the Level Thumbnails community) as the menu background. The toolbar's music button opens the player.

ui-sound-volume.name: UI sound volume
ui-sound-volume.description: Volume of the menu's hover and click sounds, in percent of GD's SFX volume. 0 turns them off.

background-dim.name: Background dim
background-dim.description: How much to darken the menu background, in percent.

background-blur.name: Blur background
background-blur.description: Blur the menu background, like osu!.

background-triangles.name: Background triangles
background-triangles.description: Show slowly drifting triangles over the background.
